notes.title: Aeland Nobility Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r8DH0Mh.jpeg[/img]

[olist]
[*] Added a quest tracker arrow to point you in the right direction (a highly requested feature).
[*] Nellen Fortress interior now completed.
[*] Implemented a workaround for Steam Input gamepads not being detected (please use the official Akhena gamepad configuration in Steam)
[*] Added gamepad control legend to the bottom right corner of the screen (can be hidden).
[*] Improved the jump mechanic to be able to effectively “climb” up 1 block high ledges.
[*] Added the ability to skip dialogue by holding the cancel button.
[*] Significantly decreased chance of detection when stealing, making casual thievery more viable.
[*] Minor performance improvements.
[*] Fixed a number of small bugs.
[/olist]
Known pending issues:

[list]
[*] Game still freezes after battle on Windows 10 machines (cause unknown).
[*] Performance is still poor on low powered devices like the Steam Deck.
[/list]

notes.title: Pixie Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LX8ZdXS.jpeg[/img]


[olist]
[*] Completed Caylen Grove map
[*] Added pikmera (pixie) map sprites and story characters
[*] Added the start quests for all four primary factions in Aeland
[*] Increased the quality of items in chests and barrels while trespassing
[*] Increased the quality of items in locked chests (compounds with above)
[*] Added an inn, a tavern, and a purchasable house to Iverville
[*] Minor redesign of the character portrait HUD items
[*] Fixed a bug where the saved game character portraits don’t fully load
[*] Fixed a number of minor bugs
[*] Known persistent bug: display occasionally freezes after battle
[/olist]

notes.title: Red Letterhouse Update
notes.content:
My apologies for taking so long to push an update. Life outside of Akhena has been very busy lately. Hopefully I can spend more time on game dev in 2025. -Andrew

[list]
[*] Multiple small bug fixes and improvements.
[*] Some work on maps like Caylen Grove and Fort Gamber.
[*] Added the Red Letterhouse interior in Upper Cliffdon.
[/list]
